description: Top TikTok sounds used in viral app-marketing videos over the last 14, 30 or 90 days, overall or for one niche. Use 14 days for what is trending now and 90 days for proven sounds in a niche (short windows have few sounds per niche). Each sound comes with its viral-video, creator and app counts, total views, niches, TikTok-wide usage and growth (top sounds), a "Use this sound" link and its top videos. Covers every sound in those videos, ranked by total views. Refreshed weekly.
